summary.repair_iteration_note: Repair-23 resolves the latest actionable Codex review findings for provider endpoint gating, PR-backed rule provenance, and the canonical experience outcome terminal field.
implemented_contracts: relia check now fails closed with exit 8 when distill.embeddings is provider and the config lacks a complete model_provider_endpoint grant.

The provider endpoint grant contract is represented in schemas/relia-config.schema.json with provider, model, endpoint or base_url, credential_env, budget_posture, redaction_posture, and allowlist fields.
relia check now rejects memory rule provenance lists that are present but do not parse as PR-backed provenance objects.
schemas/experience-record.schema.json now uses canonical outcome.terminal instead of requiring non-canonical terminal_state.
cmd/relia/main_test.go includes red/green regression coverage for the repaired provider, provenance, and experience-record contracts.
README.md, docs/dev/dev_guides.md, docs/architecture/architecture_guides.md, and docs/architecture/decision-0002-product-contracts-and-privacy-defaults.md document the repaired contracts.

resolved_review_findings.summary: Provider embeddings now require a complete model_provider_endpoint grant before relia check accepts the config.
Memory rule provenance validation now rejects non-object or inline scalar provenance lists that lack PR citations.
The experience record schema accepts the PRD canonical outcome.terminal field.

summary.lifecycle_boundary: task-executor repair only; commit, PR update, scope closure, validation-gate, and post-merge evidence are left to their required workers
